en: A black-and-white postcard view of a small lake with several rowboats on the water and tied along a wooden pier. On the right shore stands a round pavilion with a hipped roof and white columns, surrounded by lush trees and garden plantings. Benches line the lakeside path, and in the background a large villa-like building is partly visible behind the trees. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Gondelteich with the pavilion 'Haus am See' in Bad Elster.
